correctness.rationale: Normalize base to (0,0,0),(1,0,0),(0,1,0), and apices to (s,t,h),(s,t,-k), λ=(1−s−t,s,t), α=h/(h+k). Compute all six outward doubled area vectors and h_{−K} at the five vertices; polytope mixed-volume identity 3V=(1/2)sum_F h_{−K}(N_F) and vol(K)=(h+k)/6 yield V/vol=2+sum_i[(λ_i−α)_++(λ_i−1+α)_+]. Polarized difference-body cubic yields 14+6sum_i(...). Jensen plus the vanishing positive parts gives the fixed-height bound, all global minimizers including the plateau, and strict upper ratio 3 only in the degenerate limit. Independently calculated SciPy convex hulls of all pairwise differences of the five vertices for five disparate (λ,α) profiles and compared their 3-volume with the closed expression (discrepancy ≤8e−15). Those samples are corroboration, not the general proof.

originality.rationale: A complete published related closed mixed-volume result for truncated simplices was materially read; its n=3 member is a six-vertex triangular frustum, not a five-vertex triangular bipyramid. Universal Godbersen inequalities yield the upper endpoint but neither the six positive-part profile nor the positive-dimensional flat minimum 2. The evaluated natural five-vertex family and equality locus therefore survive the implicated prior statements on inspected evidence; unindexed earlier bipyramid calculations remain possible.
